comparison.objective: Withdraw a rod 17.2 cm uphill through guards by alternating hand-over-hand grips.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual grip exchange under gravity, constrained linear extraction, and guide protection.
comparison.success_condition: Travel tiers score 0.25/0.5/0.75/1.0 up to 17.2 cm, gated by guide disturbance.
comparison.reason: Tests continuous guarded extraction and regrasping against rollback. The candidate tests stabilized mandrel hammering, discrete notch fracture, coil preservation, and recovery of four free tangs. No spec versions were provided.
